name: SCING
method_summary: SCING infers robust gene regulatory networks from single-cell, single-nucleus, or spatial transcriptomics by clustering observations into supercells, building many subsampled GRNs with gene-neighborhood-limited gradient boosting regressors, retaining consensus edges, and pruning reversed, cyclic, and conditionally redundant edges with conditional mutual information.

threading.upstream_mapping: Wrapper --threads maps to SCING grnBuilder(ncore=threads) and NetworkMerger(ncore=threads). grnBuilder uses ncore for sklearn NearestNeighbors(n_jobs=ncore) and a Dask LocalCluster with n_workers=ncore; NetworkMerger uses ncore for its Dask LocalCluster during conditional mutual-information pruning. The wrapper should pin BLAS/OpenMP/NUMEXPR intra-process thread counts to 1 to avoid nested oversubscription while SCING's Dask worker pools own the assigned worker count.

compatibility_rules.message: SCING requires at least two expression genes because the selected GRN interface predicts each target gene from candidate upstream genes.
SCING requires at least two expression columns because the selected interface clusters cells/spots into supercells before building subsampled networks.
SCING network_hvgs must be -1 to keep all available genes or at least 2 to leave a possible regulator-target pair.
SCING gene_neighbors must be smaller than the number of expression genes because grnBuilder asks sklearn for gene_neighbors + 1 gene neighbors before dropping self-neighbors.
SCING gene_pcs must be smaller than the number of expression genes for the gene-level PCA used before nearest-neighbor feature selection.
SCING gene_pcs must be smaller than the number of expression columns; after supercell construction and subsampling there cannot be more independent expression columns than the input dataset provides.

conditional_required.message: groups is required when execution.mode=group_emulated because ANDREA partitions the dataset by group and runs SCING independently for each group.
conditional_required.usage: ANDREA uses groups.tsv to create one SCING child run per group; each child receives that group's expression matrix and SCING itself does not consume groups.tsv.

progress.note: The selected public notebook/API runs supercell construction, repeated grnBuilder jobs, and NetworkMerger pruning without a stable progress callback. The wrapper reports coarse lifecycle states in progress.json and preserves upstream diagnostics in scing.log.

n_supercells.description: Target number of Leiden-derived supercells passed to supercells.supercell_pipeline(..., ncell=n_supercells). The paper selected 500 supercells as a balance between sparsity reduction, runtime and robustness.

supercell_hvgs.description: Number of highly variable genes used inside supercells.supercell_pipeline(..., ngenes=supercell_hvgs) for the preprocessing step that builds the cell/spot graph before merging observations into supercells.

supercell_pcs.description: Number of principal components requested by supercells.supercell_pipeline(..., npcs=supercell_pcs) while constructing the graph used for Leiden supercell clustering. Upstream clips this value against the available observations in preprocess_data().

n_subsample_networks.description: Number of subsampled GRNs to build before consensus merging. The paper identifies 100 subsampled networks as the default study setting after benchmarking larger and smaller values.

network_hvgs.description: Number of genes retained by grnBuilder.filter_genes() for each subsampled network. -1 preserves upstream tutorial behavior by keeping all non-empty, non-duplicate genes after SCING preprocessing; positive values select that many highly variable genes.

gene_neighbors.description: Number of nearest gene neighbors passed to grnBuilder(..., nneighbors=gene_neighbors) to limit candidate upstream regulators for each target gene before gradient boosting regression.

gene_pcs.description: Number of principal components passed to grnBuilder(..., npcs=gene_pcs) for gene-level PCA before candidate regulator nearest-neighbor search. The paper's cell-type example uses 10 PCs.

subsample_fraction.description: Fraction of supercells sampled without replacement for each intermediate grnBuilder run. SCING applications report 70 percent subsamples; 1 disables subsampling in upstream grnBuilder.subsample_cells().

edge_consensus_threshold.description: Minimum fraction of subsampled networks required during NetworkMerger consensus filtering. The paper uses 20 percent as the default; the source keeps edges whose FractionAppeared is strictly greater than this threshold.

remove_cycles.description: Whether to pass cycles=true to NetworkMerger so the selected pipeline removes directed cycles before conditional mutual-information pruning, matching the paper's final-network description.

random_seed.description: Base seed for grnBuilder subsampling. The wrapper should pass random_seed + network_index to repeated public grnBuilder invocations so the bagging step is reproducible while using distinct subsamples.

artifacts_aux.description: Combined wrapper and upstream SCING stdout/stderr log.
Raw SCING merged directed network with source, target and importance columns before conversion to ANDREA network.csv.
Raw per-subsample grnBuilder edge lists produced before NetworkMerger consensus merging.
Resolved SCING parameters, expression dimensions, selected execution mode, runtime thread mapping and pinned upstream commit.
